cohort: The study discusses pregnant patients globally, focusing on those affected by the COVID-19 pandemic.
finding: The abstract highlights a significant increase in cesarean section rates among pregnant women during the COVID-19 pandemic and notes the elevated risk of severe illness, ICU admission, and death in pregnant women infected with COVID-19.
mod_finding: The abstract reports that around 64% of pregnant women with COVID-19 delivered via cesarean route, with rates reaching 93% in China.
